title: AVALANCHE BED
description: A continuous granular ridge receives autonomous feed and relaxes by a controllable angle of repose. Drag above the surface pours material; drag into the bed excavates it. Cohesion and compaction change whether the landscape flows, clumps or holds steep cuts.

visual_finish.composition: a broad earthen ridge spans the frame with a clear evolving silhouette and restrained stratification marks
visual_finish.material_model: dry-to-compacted ochre granular bed with a bright crest and dark compressed strata
